title: Pricing a Self-Pay Line in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Clause.** A self-pay line in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program costs the quantity multiplied by the item's cash price. A beyond-schedule self-pay line on a coverage schedule receives no discount. A self-pay line is charged to the card on file on its ship date and never posts to a coverage account. The Self-Pay Supply Subscription has no unit limits but still follows the schedule's maximum months per shipment.

**Retired wording.** The clause "on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription the schedule's subscription discount applies to every line, rounded to the cent half up per line" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis. The rest of this clause remains in force.

## Applying the clause

| Line | Price of the line | Discount under this clause |
|---|---|---|
| Beyond-schedule self-pay line on a coverage schedule | quantity multiplied by the cash price | none |

*Worked example (hypothetical cash price):* a patient on a coverage schedule buys 3 units beyond the schedule of an item whose cash price is 12.00. The line costs 3 multiplied by 12.00, which is 36.00, with no discount, charged to the card on file on the ship date.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a self-pay line ever post to the patient's coverage account?** No. It is charged to the card on file on its ship date and never posts to a coverage account.

**Is a Self-Pay Supply Subscription shipment free of the months-per-shipment limit, since the subscription has no unit limits?** No. The subscription has no unit limits but still follows the schedule's maximum months per shipment.

superseded_clauses: on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription the `subscription_discount_pct` discount applies to every line, rounded to the cent half up per line
